Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease

Required findings: Dynamic segmental instability on flexion‑extension plain x‑rays or supine vs upright images showing >3 mm translational shift at the requested level
Meyerding grade II or higher spondylolisthesis at the requested level
Daily significant pain causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores or prolonged standing)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement after at least three consecutive months of either prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids/steroids OR a provider‑directed exercise program (unless contraindicated)
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Nicotine‑free status: never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with objective cotinine test confirming normal range
Meyerding grade I‑II with radiographic evidence of progression, or grade III‑IV with ≥50 % anterior slippage or radiographic progression
Multi‑level spondylolysis on plain x‑rays may also satisfy imaging criteria
Daily significant pain causing functional impairment

Less than clinically meaningful improvement after at least three consecutive months of either prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids/steroids OR a provider‑directed exercise program (unless contraindicated)
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Nicotine‑free status: never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with objective cotinine test

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease
Required findings: Plain x‑rays and advanced imaging (CT or MRI) demonstrating moderate to severe single‑level disc degeneration at the requested level
Chronic, unremitting discogenic axial low‑back pain with disability for ≥12 months
Structured, physician‑supervised, multimodal non‑operative management including regular scheduled visits and follow‑up

Less than clinically meaningful improvement after at least two of the following for ≥12 months: prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids/steroids, provider‑directed exercise program, epidural steroid injection or selective nerve root block at the same level, facet joint injection/medial branch block/radiofrequency ablation
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Nicotine‑free status: never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with objective cotinine test
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5 > Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease

Required findings: Imaging showing either coronal deformity (Cobb angle >30°, asymmetric disc collapse with foraminal narrowing, or global coronal imbalance) or sagittal imbalance (sagittal vertical axis >8 cm or pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis mismatch >15°)
Daily significant pain with functional impairment

Less than clinically meaningful improvement after at least three consecutive months of either prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids/steroids OR a provider‑directed exercise program (unless contraindicated)
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Nicotine‑free status: never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with objective cotinine test
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5 > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity

Non-Indications: Absence of the specified imaging findings (e.g., no dynamic instability, spondylolisthesis grade below required threshold, no moderate‑to‑severe disc degeneration, or deformity measurements below criteria)
Failure to complete the required duration of conservative therapy (e.g., less than 3 months of medication/exercise trial for spondylolisthesis or less than 12 months for discogenic disease)
Presence of unmanaged major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid use disorder, or alcohol use disorder
Current smoking or nicotine use within 6 weeks of planned surgery without documented cotinine‑negative test
Inadequate documentation of conservative treatment attempts or lack of multidisciplinary non‑operative management
Important criteria & exceptions: Nicotine‑free verification must be supported by objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva) showing results within normal range for the assay used
Mental health disorders must be documented as managed; unmanaged disorders constitute a denial
For discogenic disease, improvement must be insufficient after at least two of the listed conservative modalities for a minimum of 12 months
Conservative therapy may be waived only if contraindicated and documented
Multi‑level procedures require that each level independently meet the imaging and symptom criteria
Documentation required: Flexion‑extension plain radiographs or supine and upright radiographs with measurement of translational shift
Standard standing plain radiographs with measurement of Meyerding grade for spondylolisthesis
MRI or CT report detailing disc degeneration severity and level(s) involved
Cobb angle measurement report for coronal deformity and sagittal vertical axis/pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis measurements for sagittal imbalance
Prescription records showing use of analgesics, NSAIDs, gabapentinoids, steroids and duration of therapy
Physical therapy or chiropractic notes confirming prescribed exercise program and duration
Procedural reports for epidural steroid injections, selective nerve root blocks, facet joint injections, medial branch blocks, or radiofrequency ablations (if used)
Mental health assessment documenting absence of unmanaged psychiatric or substance‑use disorders
Smoking status documentation and cotinine test result (serum, urine, or saliva) confirming nicotine‑free status
Operative report request form indicating CPT 22533 and level(s) to be fused
